mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, nickname, avatar, role, security_question, security_answer, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{securityQuestion}, #{securityAnswer}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, role = #{role}, security_question = #{securityQuestion}, security_answer = #{securityAnswer}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role, create_time, update_time, security_question, security_answer FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role, create_time, update_time, security_question, security_answer FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role, create_time, update_time, security_question, security_answer FROM sys_user ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role, create_time, update_time, security_question, security_answer FROM sys_user ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
